he asked .

we work .

by friday brett trumped her by ordering her into his office late in the afternoon .

she asked politely , standing in the doorway to his office , not daring to come inside .
brett looked up from the file folder he was reading and nodded his head towards an empty chair in front of his desk , indicating that she should take a seat .
instead of taking the chair , antonia stepped into the office but only a few feet .

why are you avoiding me ? ''
antonia 's raised an eyebrow sardonically .

she snapped right back .
brett leaned both hands against his desk and glared at her .
`` what 's going on ?
i know you love me so what 's your issue with this wedding ? ''
his comment took all the wind out of her .
and in a small voice , she replied , `` no one asked me . ''

you just told me . ''

antonia nodded .
`` yes , i probably would have . ''
he demanded .
`` i explained all this before .
i 've spent my whole life being controlled by my father or my brothers .

`` believe it or not , i did n't do any of those things .

antonia blinked back the tears .
`` you did n't ? ''
brett shook his head and crossed his arms over his chest .
`` nope . ''

as she thought back to the conversations with the bank managers , all of them had mentioned one of her brothers .

brett stilled .

`` yes , i 've been falling asleep early each night .
yes , i 've also been avoiding you for fear of your reaction .
yes , i 'll marry you .

`` i 'm glad that we have a wedding already planned .

`` brett ... '' antonia started , feeling shy once again .
`` i love you too , '' was all he said before bending to kiss her again .
